atDirectives.name: @theme
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: declares design tokens (colors, fonts, spacing…) that become utility classes. `@theme inline` references the variables by name instead of copying their values.

atDirectives.name: @source
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: adds a path to scan for class names.

atDirectives.name: @utility
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines a custom utility class.

atDirectives.name: @variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: applies a variant (hover, dark, …) inside plain CSS.

atDirectives.name: @custom-variant
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: defines a new variant.

atDirectives.name: @apply
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS: inlines utility classes into a CSS rule.

atDirectives.name: @reference
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: makes theme variables and utilities available in a separate CSS file (e.g. CSS modules) without emitting them.

atDirectives.name: @config
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a legacy JavaScript config file.

atDirectives.name: @plugin
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS v4: loads a JavaScript plugin.

atDirectives.name: @tailwind
atDirectives.description: Tailwind CSS (v3 style): injects base, components or utilities.
